assessments.reasoning: The supplied document [M] Metodologia_ECH_2021.pdf does not contain a conceptual definition of household headship ('jefe' or 'jefa de hogar'). Section 7.1 mentions that information for the household is provided by a qualified informant ('informante calificado'), but does not define household headship. The Glosario section (pp. 69-70) defines various survey concepts (such as 'Elegibles Respondentes', 'Tasa de Actividad', 'Unidad Primaria de muestreo'), but excludes any entry or definition for household head or household headship. An interviewer manual [G], which might document such operational definitions, was not supplied in this run.
